issue.title: Collection cards adopt the title block: album, record, and bank cards wear their species, and album and record cards own the note title from the title slot
issue.description: On desktop Obsidian, every album note and record note opens on its card in the title slot above native Properties, and that card is the note's only visible title. The album card paints its title from local data at once, hides its redundant H1 at render time, and folds its schema to one line. The record card carries the RECORD kicker, a sheet tile, and paper material, with its walk rail docked at its bottom. The bank Setup card gains the BANK kicker and tile. The Record Card and album card editor headers show the species tile and word. Every failure restores native rendering.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202611/collection_cards_title_block.md requests this work

payload.entry: PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: bob-cli docs/reference/vault-format.md is over its word budget (6016 > 6000 for reference/) on bob-cli master 2443e0a4 — bob-plugins `npm run docs:check` (BOB_CLI_DIR set) fails on it with a clean bob-plugins tree; no bead tracks it.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: real-Obsidian Ctrl+J/Ctrl+K group/field jumps fail in card editors — bank Setup e2e setup-group-jump-ctrl-k and album UI e2e schema-field-jump-ctrl-j (real key moved=false) fail identically on clean bob-plugins c5f5a1b; untracked.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: obsidian-bank-ui-e2e-setup.cjs aborts at "timed out waiting for bank arrangement saved after one Enter" (state preview-ready, dirty) and setup-arrange-dry-run-budget times out on preview 2 in 2 of 3 runs, all on clean c5f5a1b too; the abort skips every later Setup e2e section (processFrontMatter header, plugin-disabled), so those go unverified.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: obsidian-bank-ui-e2e.cjs fails queue-card-live/queue-card-reading ("missing import command"), invalid-fence, and walk-learn-coffee/walk-learn-accept (RangeError: Invalid line number 0) with identical verdicts on clean c5f5a1b; untracked.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: in Live Preview the bank card is an inline widget at the end of the `# 🏦 Bank` line, so it inherits the H1 font size (head, collapsed line, and buttons render at heading size; pre-existing on c5f5a1b); the new BANK badge uses --font-ui-small and reads small beside it. Consider a block widget or resetting font-size on .bob-bank-setup.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: obsidian-album-ui-e2e.cjs default executable /snap/obsidian/current/app/obsidian exits before the fixture vault window on athena ("owned Obsidian process exited"), as does obsidian-bank-ui-e2e.cjs with that path; -e /snap/bin/obsidian works. Default the album e2e to /snap/bin/obsidian or document it.
